description: A Site Context turn that proposes a three-part series of drafts through ai/propose-drafts, which ends the turn. Entry 1 answers the follow-up after the proposal is settled.

content.text: I will propose a three-part series for you to review.

items.title: Getting Started with Blocks
items.excerpt: What a block is, and how to add your first one.
items.content: Blocks are the pieces a page is built from. This first part shows how to add, move and remove them.

items.title: Building a Page Layout
items.content: Once you know blocks, you can arrange them. This part covers columns, groups and the spacing controls.

items.title: Reusing Your Best Blocks
items.content: Patterns save a set of blocks to use again. This part shows how to make one and when to sync it.

content.text: Noted what you decided about the series. Want me to outline part four?
